messages.充電を補充しつつパッシブでダメージ量を底上げし、充電人格の火力を引き上げる、嫉妬: A high-power Envy Pierce E.G.O that refills Charge while raising damage through its passive, boosting the damage of Charge Identities.
messages.高いマッチ威力: 20~26(解析Ⅲで22~28)と高めで、的中時に麻痺3を付与: **High Clash Power**: A high 20–26, or 22–28 at Threadspin Ⅲ, and inflicts 3 Paralyze on hit.
messages.充電の獲得: 的中時(解析Ⅳは攻撃後)に自分の充電回数が増える(解析Ⅲで7)。解: **Gaining Charge**: On hit (after the attack at Threadspin Ⅳ), increases her own Charge Count, to 7 at Threadspin Ⅲ. At Threadspin Ⅳ, it increases by another 3 at the end of a Heads attack.
messages.味方への支援(解析Ⅲ。解析Ⅳは表面攻撃終了時): 表面的中時に、次のターンにラン: **Support for allies (Threadspin Ⅲ; at the end of a Heads attack at Threadspin Ⅳ)**: On Heads Hit, gives 1 Envy Power Up and 1 Haste next turn to 2 random allies. The targets cannot be chosen.
messages.広域化(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が1から3になり、複数の敵を同時に攻撃できる。: **Multi-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight rises from 1 to 3, letting it hit several enemies at once.
messages.パッシブ「適応型放出」: 充電回数1つにつきダメージ量+2%。スキル効果で消耗す: **Passive — Adaptive Release**: +2% damage per Charge Count. Reduces the Charge Count spent by skill effects by 2.
messages.充電を使う人格と組み、立ち上がりで不足しがちな充電をこのE.G.Oで補う。: Pair it with Identities that use Charge, and use this E.G.O to cover the Charge that tends to be lacking at the start.
messages.麻痺は撃ったターンだけ効くので、速度が高い人格で撃つ。: Paralyze only works on the turn it is used, so fire it with a fast Identity.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と充電獲得量が増え、覚醒に味方への嫉妬威力増加・クイックが付く。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and Charge gain, and adds Envy Power Up and Haste for allies to Awakening.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、充電獲得が攻撃後に変わる。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and the Charge gain moves to after the attack.
messages.マルチクラック事務所 代表: S1・S3が充電を消耗または獲得するスキルで、S1: **[MultiCrack Office Rep](persona:0210)**: S1 and S3 spend or gain Charge, and her Lust S1 and Envy S2 supply resources.
messages.W社2級整理要員: S1・S2が充電を増やし、S1の嫉妬と S3の憤怒でも必要資: **[W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent](persona:0202)**: S1 and S2 increase Charge, and her Envy S1 and Wrath S3 also supply the required affinities.
